metadata.description: Curated resources for i18n/l10n in modern web applications covering libraries, standards, TMS platforms, AI translation, and best practices.
metadata.title: Software Localisation - Sources

official_documentation.name: FormatJS / react-intl

official_documentation.name: vue-i18n Documentation

official_documentation.name: Angular Internationalization

official_documentation.name: next-intl Documentation

official_documentation.name: LinguiJS Documentation

official_documentation.name: typesafe-i18n Documentation

standards_specifications.name: ICU Message Format
standards_specifications.relevance: Canonical ICU message syntax specification. Pluralisation, select, formatting.

standards_specifications.name: Unicode CLDR
standards_specifications.relevance: Common Locale Data Repository. Plural rules, date/number formats by locale. Version and per-language category counts change on each release (CLDR 48.2 was current as of March 2026, CLDR 49 planned for October 2026) — always re-check the live chart rather than a cached version number.

standards_specifications.name: BCP 47 Language Tags
standards_specifications.relevance: IETF standard for language tags (en-US, de-DE). Used in Accept-Language headers.

standards_specifications.name: MDN Intl API
standards_specifications.relevance: JavaScript Internationalization API. DateTimeFormat, NumberFormat, Collator.

standards_specifications.name: ECMAScript Internationalization API
standards_specifications.relevance: ECMA-402 specification. Defines Intl object and locale-sensitive operations.

ai_translation.name: Forrester Wave TMS Q3 2025
ai_translation.relevance: Enterprise TMS market evaluation covering Phrase, Lokalise, Crowdin, and 9 other vendors. Vendor rankings and feature sets shift yearly — treat this as directional context, not a current-quarter ranking, and check for a newer Wave before citing a leader/challenger position.

ai_translation.name: MessageFormat 2.0 Documentation
ai_translation.relevance: ICU MessageFormat 2.0 specification. LDML syntax reached Final Candidate/stabilized status, but ICU's Java implementation is only draft-status and the C++ implementation remains a technology preview as of mid-2026; no major i18n library or TMS has shipped production MF2 support. Re-verify implementation status before recommending migration.

accessibility_regulation.name: European Accessibility Act (EAA) — European Commission
accessibility_regulation.relevance: Enforceable since 28 June 2025 for EU-market products/services placed after that date (transition to 28 June 2030 for pre-existing services). Accessibility law, not a translation mandate, but interlocks with EU rules requiring consumer information in the member-state language. Verify current scope/deadlines before advising a compliance date.

mcp.name: Model Context Protocol (spec)
mcp.description: Canonical Model Context Protocol: concepts, architecture, ecosystem. The dominant current pattern for connecting AI apps/agents to external tools and data.

mcp.name: MCP — Build a Server
mcp.description: Official guide to building MCP servers (exposing tools/data to AI agents). Resolve current SDK and tooling at use-time.

security_advisories.name: Vue I18n Security Advisory GHSA-p2ph-7g93-hw3m
security_advisories.relevance: Official Vue I18n XSS advisory covering affected 9.x-11.x lines and patched versions.

security_advisories.name: Vue I18n Security Advisory GHSA-9r9m-ffp6-9x4v
security_advisories.relevance: Official Vue I18n advisory to verify package versions against before recommending upgrades.

security_advisories.name: Vue I18n Security Advisory GHSA-x8qp-wqqm-57ph (CVE-2025-53892)
security_advisories.relevance: escapeParameterHtml fails to prevent tag-based DOM XSS via v-html. Fixed in 9.14.5, 10.0.8, 11.1.10. Verify current package version before recommending v-html with translated content.

security_advisories.name: Angular i18n Security Advisory GHSA-prjf-86w9-mfqv (CVE-2026-27970)
security_advisories.relevance: XSS in Angular's ICU/i18n pipeline when translation files are compromised and rendered without CSP/Trusted Types. Fixed in 21.2.0, 21.1.6, 20.3.17, 19.2.19.
